title: On decoating of polymer electrolyte-based solid-state battery cathodes
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,2377-2389
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00082C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anna Thielen, Thomas Leißner, Tobias Eisenmann, Urs A. Peuker
This study highlights the need for early recycling of solid-state battery cathodes. Wet processing achieves 98% decoating efficiency, avoiding the 25% material loss from thermal treatment, enabling full recovery, and supporting sustainability.
